correctness.rationale: For the explicit Herschel graph, complete double enumeration gives 124/346/658 augmented faces. Three exact staged element matchings leave critical profiles 2 dimension-two, 10 dimension-three, and three dimension-four plus one dimension-five, with 349/1150/2536 Hasse incidences independently checked acyclic. Exact integral unit-pivot algebraic Morse cancellations yield identically zero remaining differentials, including the 3-by-1 last attaching-degree column. Hurewicz in dimension four makes the final five-cell attaching map null; stage inclusions are null by connectivity. Direct GF(2) chain ranks independently corroborate all homology ranks.

value.rationale: The Herschel graph is a uniquely small natural nonhamiltonian polyhedral graph with published ordinary independence topology. A complete initial three-cutoff homotopy filtration is intrinsically motivated and includes previously unknown exact two- and three-independence stages, a mixed-dimensional integral wedge and two null transition maps. These are stronger and more informative than face counts or field Betti ranks; no generalization beyond the exact graph is claimed.
